Reporting to the Director of Counseling and Psychological Services, the CARE Director oversees confidential campus advocacy and prevention services for sexual assault, intimate partner/domestic violence, and stalking. The incumbent is directly responsible for the supervision of CARE staff and establishes and achieves departmental goals and objectives through coordinated achievements of all CARE professionals and student staff. This CARE Director serves as a manager and university spokesperson, expert, strategist, policy analyst, and advocate for all campus-wide interpersonal violence issues related to students, staff, and faculty.

The CARE Director is responsible for critical incident management and consultation to leadership on high-risk scenarios related to sexual assault, intimate partner/domestic violence, and stalking, and participates in and leads committees and task forces responding to a variety of issues in relation to sexual violence and assault, and handles sensitive situations as needed. The incumbent ensures the implementation of scientifically driven prevention education best practices for students, staff, and faculty in relation to sexual violence and assault.

The CARE Director draws from a theoretical and philosophical foundation in student services and specialized expertise and knowledge of sexual assault issues and victim advocacy, including survivor recovery, medical, legal, and adjudication procedures, to conduct risk mitigation for campus health and safety and serve as a subject matter expert on sexual assault, intimate partner/domestic violence, and stalking.
Strong theoretical and philosophical foundation in student services.
Selected candidate will be required to successfully complete a pre-hire criminal history background check and a pre-hire credentialing check.
Mastery of standard office applications and digital communication platforms, with a strong aptitude for learning new internal systems necessary to perform the requirements of the position.

Selected candidate will be required to complete training within established time frames as directed including UC compliance training.

The selected candidate will be required to work primarily on campus, with periods of remote work possible based on operational needs. If a hybrid work schedule is confirmed, the selected candidate must be able to work successfully from a home/remote office and be able to fulfill the requirements of the UCSC telecommuting agreement.

Will be required to comply with current Student Health Center employee health safety requirements for health care workers as defined by state and federal regulatory agencies. Current health safety requirements are discussed during interview.

Exercise the utmost discretion in managing sensitive information learned in the course of performing their duties. Sensitive information includes but is not limited to employee and student records, health and patient records, financial data, strategic plans, proprietary information and any other sensitive or non-public information learned during the course and scope of employment. Understands that sensitive information should be shared on a limited basis and actively takes steps to limit access to sensitive information to individuals who have legitimate business need to know. Ensure that sensitive information is properly safeguarded. Follow all organizational policies and laws on data protection and privacy. This includes secure handling of physical and digital records and proper usage of IT systems to prevent data leaks. The unauthorized or improper disclosure of confidential work-related information obtained from any source on any work-related matter is a violation of these expectations.

Ability to maintain appearance and conduct suitable for working in a professional setting.

Solid skills in decision-making, analysis, critical thinking, project management, and organizational leadership. Ability to effectively solve problems and make recommendations and decisions in response to critical incidents when protocols are absent.

Well-developed oral communication skills with the ability to speak clearly and present detailed and complex information.

Ability to maintain strict confidence of privileged information and perform a wide range of duties that require tact, sensitivity, independent judgment, diplomacy, organizational skills, flexibility and discretion
